description: This file defines the core connection management for Playwright, including the Connection class that handles message dispatch, object creation, and event handling between the client and server components.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root object in the Playwright connection, responsible for initializing the Playwright instance.

classes.name: DummyChannelOwner
classes.description: A placeholder class extending ChannelOwner, used internally.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Manages the connection lifecycle, message dispatch, object creation, and event handling for Playwright.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Playwright instance via the root object.

methods.name: isRemote
methods.description: Checks if the connection is remote.

methods.name: rawBuffers
methods.description: Returns whether raw buffer mode is enabled.

methods.name: localUtils
methods.description: Returns the localUtils instance if available.

methods.name: initializePlaywright
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Playwright instance.

methods.name: getObjectWithKnownName
methods.description: Retrieves a stored object by its GUID.

methods.name: setIsTracing
methods.description: Increments or decrements the tracing count.

methods.name: sendMessageToServer
methods.description: Sends a message to the server and manages callbacks.

methods.name: _validatorFromWireContext
methods.description: Creates a ValidatorContext for wire message validation.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages, handling responses and events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and rejects pending callbacks.

methods.name: _tChannelImplFromWire
methods.description: Resolves channel implementations from wire messages.

methods.name: _createRemoteObject
methods.description: Creates remote objects based on type and initializer data.
